cases.text: There are several possible outcomes. If the cache, the result. If the server, the response.
There are several possible outcomes. If the cache matches, the result. If the cache misses, the operation.
There are several possible outcomes. If the cache, return the result. If the server, run the operation.
There are several possible outcomes. If all requests can be completed the requests finish. If the edge has reached the completed state the outgoing requests are canceled.
There are several possible outcomes. If the cache of the current operation is valid. If the cache of the preceding operation is stale.
There are several possible outcomes. If the cache could be entirely valid. If the server could be entirely ready.
There are several possible outcomes. If the cache could always be valid. If the server could always be ready.
There are several possible outcomes. If the cache is valid and the server is ready. If the server is ready and the client is connected.
There are several possible outcomes. If the cache matches, do not return stale data. If the cache misses, do not skip validation.
There are several possible outcomes. If the cache matches, the client returns the result. If the cache misses, the server runs the operation.
